dict.string: AvestaCode uses automation when you explicitly ask a terminal or review action to interact with another application.
AvestaCode needs access to workspace repositories that you store on your Desktop.
AvestaCode needs access to workspace repositories that you store in Documents.
AvestaCode needs access to repositories and files that you choose from Downloads.
AvestaCode needs access to workspace repositories that you choose in cloud-backed file provider locations.
AvestaCode needs access to workspace repositories that you choose on network volumes.
AvestaCode needs access to workspace repositories that you choose on removable volumes.
